name: jev-skills
description: Replaces the built-in skill listing with a Jev-picked shortlist of the skills each prompt needs, and adds further picks to later prompts without touching the cached history.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Shortlist skills with Jev. /jev-skills on and off change this for the running session.

maxPicks.title: Maximum picks
maxPicks.description: At most this many skills are shortlisted for the session listing and again for each later prompt.

minScore.title: Minimum score
minScore.description: Minimum Jev probability (0 to 1) for a skill to be shortlisted.

recentPrompts.title: Recent prompts
recentPrompts.description: How many of your earlier prompts Jev sees beside the current one.

jevTimeoutMs.title: Jev request timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: A Jev request is abandoned after this long and the built-in listing is left alone. Held under the hook's 10 s budget.

maxRequestTokens.title: Jev request ceiling (tokens)
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token ceiling of one Jev request (Jev accepts 32k). More skills than fit are split into batches.

maxBatches.title: Maximum Jev requests per prompt
maxBatches.description: Skills that would need more requests than this are cut to the best keyword matches first.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Model name sent to Jev. Default jev-latest.

keyFile.title: Key file
keyFile.description: Path of a file with KEY=value lines holding JEV_COMPACTION_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Default: $HOME/.config/ai-tools/jev-compaction.env.
